main_measure.name: mean unusual 18-bar move after long bets (return minus coin's normal 18-bar drift)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: positive with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases; reject: negative with t <= -2 over at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move above median forecast minus below median

decided_by: t of the mean unusual move lies between -2 and 2.
reading: A case is the first bet (long forecast rise >= 2 from its low since the last bet) in each 18-bar grid cell counted from each window's first row, cases whose 18-bar return leaves the window are dropped, and cases exactly at the median forecast belong to neither half.
